photos.title: Surfmaster by the Sea from above
photos.what: Surfmaster I and II from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): two tall towers stand side by side along the beach, each with a swimming pool on the sand side; the beach and the Atlantic Ocean run along the right. Labels placed from coordinates (labels.json).
photos.caption: Surfmaster I and II from above: two towers, each with its own pool.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of the two Surfmaster towers in Garden City Beach, labelled, with the beach and the Atlantic Ocean to the east
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling, mosaic locked to Year=2023) on 2026-11-17; the exact request is in source_request.
photos.license_note: Same source and terms as the batch 2026-11-a NAIP records (data/2026-11-a/submarkets-garden-city/photos.json).
photos.credit: Photo: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP, public domain, via The National Map (USGS). Labels by Chapter3 Realty.
photos.changes: Chapter3 Realty cut this view from the NAIP service and added labels placed from map data

annotation_sources.Surfmaster I: middle of the county parcel footprint of the tower at 1690 N Waccamaw Dr (-78.987089, 33.589073), county.json flood.footprint_center; label.py
annotation_sources.Surfmaster II: middle of the county parcel footprint of the tower at 1620 N Waccamaw Dr (-78.987544, 33.58858), raw/distance.txt; label.py

photos.original_size: 1600x1200 crop of a 2400x1800 NAIP export, labels drawn, then resized
photos.subject_check: Looked at full size by the writer of /invest/condo-buildings/surfmaster/ on 2026-11-17. The two label points sit on the two tall towers (lot centers from county parcels), each with a pool on the sand side. It shows the towers, the beach and the Atlantic Ocean, with the coast road and canal houses behind. No person; no readable sign, plate or house number at page size.
photos.crop_note: 16x9 is the middle band of the labelled crop; 1x1 is a square cut that keeps both tower labels.
